description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.6.7-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed pinned Noctis taskbar shortcut not showing the chosen app icon
- Fixed Animated Artwork search finding nothing for artist names
- Fixed ReplayGain column showing blank for older songs
- Fixed placeholder "instrumental" text being saved as lyrics
- Fixed crackling at damaged spots in long MP3s
- Fixed blurry sidebar and Settings icons at 90% and 110% interface size
- Fixed some Settings labels staying in the old language after a switch
- Fixed Settings warnings filling the log on every open
- Fixed Avg Track Length not matching the Statistics page
- Fixed Reset Everything missing page sorts and folded sections
- Fixed "Since" dates in Settings always showing English
- Fixed Last.fm card hiding the account name
- Fixed Album Town queuing snoozed songs
- Fixed Album Town keeping the same albums on a new crowd
- Fixed Album Town albums getting stuck on each other
- Fixed Album Town showing too many names for multi-artist albums
- Fixed Album Town room text spilling out
- Fixed Album Town top bar overlapping at normal window sizes
- Fixed Songs list column drop indicator not showing
- Fixed Songs list column dividers sitting behind labels
- Fixed moved Songs list column labels appearing too bright
- Fixed Songs list sort arrow sitting on the divider
- Fixed Home Albums row growing to seven tiles after some plays
- Fixed ListenBrainz showing as on briefly at startup
- Fixed a merge clash in the Reset Everything code
- Fixed two translation file conflicts
Added
- Added New in Library section on Home
- Added adjustable album counts from 6 to 100 for Home album rows
- Added choice of which Home section comes first
- Added Import Play Counts from Last.fm or ListenBrainz
- Added Mark as No Lyrics in the Lyrics menu and Search Lyrics window
- Added Undo for Mark as No Lyrics
- Added album carousel for the Albums page
- Added Built-in Features switches in Settings for plugins
- Added option to hide the Featured Artists and Suggestions panel
- Added uninstall for any plugin
- Added Plugins section in the sidebar
- Added full screen mode for Album Town
- Added top and side menus with a fold arrow for Album Town
- Added room resizing with hover handles for Album Town
- Added building size sliders up to 18 by 9 for Album Town
- Added Clear building for Album Town
- Added ladders and stairs for Album Town
- Added new games when albums meet in Album Town
- Added lyric quotes for Album Town
Improved
- Improved idle memory use by about 45 MB
- Improved audio engine startup speed
- Improved startup memory clean-up
- Improved stall logs to say whether a stall was audible
- Improved ReplayGain scan so only songs without a value start ticked
- Improved Songs list column dragging, sorting and preview
- Improved Reset Everything to clear listening history, ratings, favorites, caches, lyrics, progress files and sign-in data
- Improved Reset Everything to stop background work before clearing
- Improved Home, Stats, Favorites and Inbox to empty immediately after a reset
- Improved column padding and divider visibility
- Improved Animated Artwork search pop-up background
- Improved Import Play Counts description
- Improved session log by removing style lines
Full Changelog: v1.6.6...v1.6.7
